citations.claim: initial total energy is ~58.86 J (mostly gravitational potential)
energy still near ~98.85 J just before contact, within bound
first energy_bound violation: energy jumps to ~348.7 J, far above allowed ~122.5 J given only ~48 J controller work
controlled light body hits at ~18.4 m/s while in contact (gap ~0.02) with heavier body
previously near-rest heavy body ejected at ~22.9 m/s, showing net energy creation in collision

explanation: Light controller-driven body (m=0.2) accelerated to ~20 m/s collides with heavier resting body (m=1). In step 10 both are in contact (gap 0.02) and total energy jumps from ~98.9 J to ~348.7 J while recorded controller work is only ~48 J, exceeding E0+work+10%+5 (~122.5 J). Likely cause: impulse/positional-correction contact solver creates energy for large mass-ratio, high-speed impact (and/or controller-work accounting misses work done during contact substeps), ejecting the heavy body at ~22.9 m/s.
vision_note: The small orange body drives rightward toward the green waypoint while the larger blue body stays nearly stationary, with the gap steadily closing over steps 7 to 9. In step 10 the two bodies arrive in direct contact with no visible separation.
